title: CatalogDocument
description: Defines the schema for a Verifiable Credential type. A Document in the Sybol Catalog is the canonical template for a W3C Verifiable Credential: it declares the credential type hierarchy, its JSON-LD context, issuance policies and the set of Claims that compose its credentialSubject.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4). Generated by the server on creation.

code.description: Globally unique SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE identifier that maps directly to a W3C VC type name (e.g. 'DNI_ES', 'UNIVERSITY_DEGREE', 'DRIVING_LICENCE_EU'). Immutable after creation.

vc_type.description: W3C Verifiable Credential @type array. The first item MUST be 'VerifiableCredential'. Subsequent items narrow the semantic type from most-general to most-specific.

context.description: JSON-LD @context array. The first item MUST be 'https://www.w3.org/2018/credentials/v1'. Additional items add domain-specific vocabulary.

schema_url.description: Published URL of the credentialSubject JSON Schema. Used as 'credentialSchema.id' in issued Verifiable Credentials, enabling wallet-side validation.

version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Breaking changes to the credentialSubject structure require a MAJOR version bump and must produce a new document code or a new version of the document.

translations.description: Multilingual metadata. Each key is a BCP 47 language tag. The entry keyed by 'default_lang_code' is the canonical version.

default_lang_code.description: BCP 47 language tag for the primary language (e.g. 'es', 'en', 'pt-BR'). MUST correspond to a key present in 'translations'.

compliance_path.description: Dot-notation path identifying the OFFICIAL ISSUING AUTHORITY of this credential type. Globally unique. Encodes sector + country + authority (e.g. 'pub.es.policiaNacional' = public sector, Spain, Policía Nacional; 'pub.eu.eidas' = EU-level eIDAS authority; 'priv.es.dgsfp' = private sector, Spain, DGSFP). This is the origin of the document definition, NOT its recognition scope. Immutable after activation.

compliance_regions.description: IDs of compliance_regions records where this credential type is LEGALLY RECOGNIZED or ACCEPTED. Orthogonal to compliance_path: a Spanish DNI (compliance_path = 'pub.es.policiaNacional') may be recognized across the entire EU (compliance_regions = ['eu', 'eu.es', 'eu.de', ...]). Enables multi-jurisdiction support without conflating origin with acceptance scope.

state.description: Lifecycle state. Allowed transitions: draft → active → deprecated → archived. Only 'active' documents may be referenced by active Forms or issued as VCs.

issuer_requirements.description: Constraints on which issuers may produce a Verifiable Credential of this type. Used during VC verification in the blockchainManager service.

revocation.description: Revocation support policy. Determines how issued VCs of this type will be revoked.

expiry_policy.description: Default validity and renewal rules for issued VCs. Verifiers use this as a hint when checking 'expirationDate'.

selective_disclosure.description: Whether credentials of this type support selective disclosure (BBS+ or SD-JWT). When true, individual Claims may expose a 'selective_disclosure_policy'.

display.description: Visual presentation hints for wallets and UIs (aligns with OID4VCI 'credentials_supported[].display').

claims.description: Claims that compose the credentialSubject of this document. Read-only, populated from the claims table. Not persisted on create/update.

label.description: Human-readable name of the credential type as shown in wallets and portals.

description.description: Full description of the credential purpose shown in detail views.

short_label.description: Compact label for cards, badges and navigation.

issuer_name.description: Locale-specific name of the expected issuing authority (e.g. 'Dirección General de Tráfico').

DocumentTranslationMap.description: Keys are BCP 47 language tags. E.g. { 'es': { 'label': 'DNI' }, 'en': { 'label': 'National ID' } }

IssuerRequirements.description: Constraints on the issuing entity. Applied during VC verification.

did_methods.description: Accepted DID methods for the issuer DID (e.g. ['did:web', 'did:ethr', 'did:key']).

trusted_issuers.description: Whitelist of trusted issuer DIDs or trusted-registry lookup URLs.

accreditation_required.description: When true, the issuer MUST appear in the trusted registry for the credential to be valid.

supported.description: Whether credentials of this type can be revoked after issuance.

method.description: Revocation mechanism. 'StatusList2021' is the W3C-recommended method.

default_validity_days.description: Default number of days the credential is valid from issuance. Used to compute 'expirationDate'.

max_validity_days.description: Maximum validity period a tenant may request when issuing this credential type.

renewable.description: Whether the credential can be renewed before expiry without re-issuance from scratch.

CredentialDisplay.description: Visual hints for wallet and portal rendering. Aligned with OID4VCI credential_supported[].display.

text_color.description: Primary text color for the credential card.

ClaimSummary.description: Lightweight reference to a Claim. Populated server-side; not accepted on write.
